responsibility: Implements the ISO RawIO interface as a thin wrapper over IOChan.RawRead and IOChan.RawWrite for arrays of SYSTEM.LOC. It computes buffer addresses and transfer counts, loops on reads until a short read or terminal read result is reported, flushes pending stdout/stderr state before reads, and delegates writes directly, making it the explicit-channel raw transfer layer above the generic channel runtime.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the operational implementation of the RawIO specification: it translates array arguments into addresses and counts, loops around IOChan.RawRead until termination conditions, and delegates writes to IOChan.RawWrite. RawIO.def only defines the standard module surface with the two raw-I/O procedures.
